LLMs attempt to infer universal concepts through training on different data. Recent work has demonstrated that LLMs encode these concepts as specific directions, referred to as steering vectors (SVs), capable of steering text generation to align with target concepts.
outputs: Text responses aligned with specific concepts such as harmfulness, happiness, fairness, etc.

The outputs include generated text responses that are modulated to reflect specific concepts such as harmfulness, happiness, fairness, and others, evaluated through probability scores, classifier assessments, or AI assistant scoring.

quote: The evaluation metric is the percentage of harmful outputs generated.

In CAA, one evaluation method is to compute probabilities that LLMs assign to choices corresponding to target concepts after adding SVs. Another evaluation method employs an AI assistant to score LLMs' outputs in open-ended generation tasks.
